topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: Mornin', neighbors. Heard the tale from the miller's boy, rode all the way from the town up to these parts on a swift breeze. Seems a young mind, one that's been at the books as long as the sun's been up, caught cribbin' from another's work. Now, I'm no scholar, just a man who reads the signs in the soil and the sky, but somethin' don't sit right with me. Whispers 'bout such mischief in the seed of a lad who's known for his toil make me scratch my head. Can you imagine that? A lad who works the parchment like the rest of us work the earth, what'd he have to gain from such a trick? I reckon there's more to this story than the first pour of the ale. Pray the folks at the keep sort it out fair and true.
